title: Item Plus EX
description: With this mod, let's add items, equipment, and blocks.
body:
# Item Plus EX

### Warning: This mod is currently not under development!
### No bug fixes or item additions will be made!
### 
This mod adds blocks, items, and equipment.

This mod will continue to evolve.
With each version upgrade (excluding minor updates), the mod will expand, adding new blocks, items, and equipment.

**Note:**
Most items are currently only obtainable in Creative mode, and very few items from this mod can be obtained in Survival mode.

We will strive to make it compatible with Survival mode as soon as possible.

***Official Website***:

https://da-wa33.github.io/Item-plus-ex/

***Supported Languages***:
English Japanese
